description: Fixed local unit/physics/missingness checks; no confirmation observations or measured material discovery claims. Reliability checks do not establish proposal quality.

response-definition.J: sum_h W_h mean_i sum_e w_e mean_r Q_hire/(N_p*E_gun)
response-definition.missing: failed, cancelled, timed-out, incomplete and malformed responses are absent
response-definition.conditional_noise: With fixed positions D, independent transport contributes noise to J_D(x); position uncertainty belongs to J(x).

sic-derived-local.status: DFT elasticity; phonon coefficients are derived assumptions, not measured; Si dynamical/DOS fields remain borrowed.

search-domain.status: Independent property model; no material identity implied.

selection.warm_inference_definition: Sum over all initial and repair calls: max(0,total_duration-load_duration)/1e9. Report actual request wall time and cold loading separately.
